prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1221; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across its center and the left tail lamp assembly is broken, with the trunk lid showing a crease along its lower edge. The pattern and location of the crush are consistent with the rear-end impact reported, and nothing observed suggests a separate or older event. Repairs proceed by replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp, repairing the trunk lid, and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours listed are in line with the work required for this damage. No prior damage to this vehicle is known to us, and the invoices submitted contain no duplicated line items.
